vetSays.line: A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Off to the well — back with a full skin." The pantry won't fill itself.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm heads out for water. "Thirst doesn't negotiate. Going." Good kit is the difference out there.
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)

You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 50s, with a slouched posture telling A man, maybe 40s, with a farmer's tan about A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek. The story's getting bigger than what happened.

🪵 A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (15 logs now.)
"You haven't earned that yet," A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek says. (Trust too low.)

A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

A person, maybe 50s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." Better close to the fire today.

🛡️ Daniela, Aubrey, Jason and Ciro met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Daniela, Aubrey, Jason, Ciro are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Daniela, Aubrey, Jason and Ciro met them at the door — 4 put down. Daniela, Aubrey, Jason, Ciro are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Victor just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Yara just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Jason, Yara and Farid met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Jason, Yara, Farid are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aubrey just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Petra just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Petra just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Helga just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Helga met them at the door — 1 put down.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
